rules.statement: The sum to be paid for compensation under Regulation 2(1)(6) is the cost of reinstating or reconstructing as on the date possession was restored, and not some other basis.
rules.supporting_quote: "(i) that upon a correct construction or application of Regulation 2 (1) (6), the sum to be paid to the claimants is the cost of re�instating or reconstructing as on 9th December 1950, of the buildings on the said premises as they stood on 4th August 1942."

meta.parties: Esufally v. Assistant Government Agent, Colombo
